statement: The proportion of infants who had hospital overnight stays is higher among low birthweight cases compared to non-low birthweight cases in the case series.
rationale: This study uses a case-only design to compare proportions of hospital overnight stays between low and non-low birthweight infant deaths within the case series. The sources provide sufficient data on both birth weight status and hospital overnight stays, allowing for this comparison without needing a denominator source.
prior_art: None in the inputs; while existing manuscripts discuss various risk factors for SUID, none directly address comparisons between low and non-low birthweight cases regarding hospital overnight stays.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causation or incidence rates. It only compares proportions of hospital overnight stays among infants based on their birth weight status, without a population reference to estimate prevalence in a broader context.
